# T-2: Split draft review flow

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Represent draft review as review-draft-questions and review-draft-coverage while preserving existing CLI compatibility.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Flow definition sequence contains both new review steps before gate-draft.
- flow-steps unit tests assert split review ordering and public draft phase mapping.
- Both new step ids have maxAttempts auto=1/manual=5.
- `flow run review --phase draft` remains accepted.
- Active flow migration handles current and downstream review-draft states.
- Retry counters, parser count keys, report artifacts, and next-action metadata are keyed by the concrete review stage id.
- Retry metrics retain public phase draft plus concrete stepId or retryKey for count/reset separation.
- Metric append/increment/agent aggregation preserves concrete step metadata while aggregating by public phase draft.
- Read-only flow scans apply migration in memory while writable loads persist migration and issue-log events.
- FlowCommand and dispatcher hook context resolution sees migrated split draft review state.
- Review post-command hooks do not auto-complete the two plan review stages.
- Public --phase validation continues to accept draft/spec/test explicitly and impl remains the no-phase default.
- flow-helpers maps draft, both concrete draft review stages, and gate-draft to public phase draft.
- `flow set retry reset review draft` resets both draft review counters or the current concrete counter according to active flow state.
- `flow set metric` uses phase draft for manual activity inside both concrete draft review stages.
- Automatic metrics and issue-log hooks also map both concrete draft review stages to public phase draft.
- `flow run review --phase draft` follows the routing matrix for before-review, concrete-stage, legacy, after-stage, and downstream states.
- FlowManager active-flow resolution applies or delegates review-draft split migration.

## Implementation Notes
Update src/flow/definition.js, src/lib/constants.js, src/lib/flow-helpers.js, src/flow/registry.js, src/flow/lib/flow-context.js, src/flow/lib/run-review.js, src/flow/lib/set-retry.js, src/flow/lib/set-metric.js, src/flow/lib/get-check.js, src/lib/flow-store.js, src/lib/flow-manager.js, review phase routing maps, set-retry/reset registries, get-next-action expectations, and migration logging. The compatibility `--phase draft` entry point must resolve to the active concrete stage, not to a resurrected review-draft node. Plan review completion stays with operator instructions and `flow set step ... done`.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for step order, retry resolution, compatibility routing, and active-flow state remapping.
